notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first only - requests to robots.txt, homepage HTML (mega-menu nav), Shopify /collections.json and /collections/<handle>/products.json all succeeded, no block encountered, Playwright/Chrome not needed. robots.txt is a standard Shopify agent policy: User-agent: * Allow: / (only cart/checkout/admin/account disallowed) - full site crawlable, no ClaudeBot-specific restriction. TREE METHOD: built from homepage mega-menu (4 top nav columns: Desk, Decor, Kitchen, Furniture, each with an 'All' + subcategory list) cross-checked against the full 64-collection /collections.json listing; canonical+h1 verified for both retained leaves (Organiser, Rug). QTY METHOD: /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 array length (single page, well under limit, so complete count) - equivalent evidence to a rendered total since Objectry's theme does not show an explicit 'N products' header. Objectry is a small design-object/decor brand (sculptural desk accessories, tableware, mirrors, clocks, rugs, furniture) - most of the 64 collections (Bowl, Cakestand, Glassware, Plate & Platter, Utensil Holder, Barware, Clock, Mirror, Lighting & Candle, Plant Holder, Coffee/Dining/End Table, Console, Seating, Hardware, Stationery, Mug, Tissue Holder, material/shape collections like Ball/Cone/Dot/Facet/Wood/Metal/Cane etc.) are Kitchen&Dining, Decorative Accessories, Lighting, Wall Decor or Furniture per those rulesets' boundary sections and were excluded as out of scope for this Textile+Storage pass. EXCLUDED - relevant to this pass: 'Storage' (/collections/storage, 16 products - mostly bookshelves/consoles/desks/cabinets/credenza/trolley, e.g. Incline Bookshelf, Tube Credenza, Staircase Cabinet) and 'Shelf' (/collections/shelf, 8 products - book racks/shelves) are BOTH explicitly nested under the site's own 'Furniture' mega-menu column, not a standalone Storage nav - per storage.md Sec21/27 (site explicitly places product inside Furniture category -> prefer Furniture) these were excluded from storage_rows; they belong to the separate completed Furniture task, not re-added here to avoid cross-category duplication. 'Uneven Place Mats - Set of 4' (decor-decoratives/functional-decoratives) checked and excluded from Textile: product page confirms material is solid wood ('thin layers of solid wood... lined with felt'), not fabric, so fails textile.md Sec16 material rule. 'Cane Dot Wall Art' (wall/decor-decoratives) excluded from Textile: cane/wood wall art, not a fabric product. 'organisers' collection (Serveware Organisers: Utensil Holder x2, Cake Set x3) excluded - Kitchen & Dining boundary (storage.md Sec13/26), not general home storage. INCLUDED: Decor > Rug (4 products: Step Rug, Terra Rug, River Rug, Yin Yang Rug - all explicitly named/marketed as rugs per product descriptions) -> Textile, HIGH confidence. Desk > Organiser (10 products incl. Basic Key Hook & Organiser, pen stands/trays, Dot Square Hooks, Corner Dustbin, Mini Polaroid Frames) -> Storage, MEDIUM confidence: site's own explicit category name is 'Organiser' (storage.md Sec7 whitelists Desk Organizers) and majority of items (key hook organizer, pen stands/trays that keep writing utensils organized, coat/hat hooks) serve a genuine organizational function, though 2 of the 10 items (Corner Dustbin, Mini Polaroid Frames) are not clearly storage-purpose - kept as one collection-level qty per project convention rather than fabricating a sub-split qty not shown on the site.
